incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired (HIGH) — route: inference-latency-embedder
PagerDuty: PD-INC-4789
Symptom: 95th tail latency > 1.5s for embedder pool rtr-emb-02
Links: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/xyz/embedder-latency
Escalation: primary oncall Maya K @pagerduty

Maya K: ack
Maya K: I'm on it. looking at the dashboard now.

Ron P: ack as backup, if you need me ping. grabbing logs.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Page acknowledged by Maya K

Maya K: quick check: rolling deploys? autoscaler? no deploys in last 30m per deploy-bot.

Priya L: I'm seeing a short burst from synthetic traffic hitting a single customer key — 5k requests in 45s
Maya K: https://logs.redwood.com/q/abcdef shows 429 spikes from embedder nodes

Santi: can you paste the exact query? I can check upstream router metrics.

Priya L: ```
curl "https://api.redwood.internal/metrics?service=embedder&window=60s" | jq '.requests | {p95,p99,errors}'
{
  "p95": 1.72,
  "p99": 2.83,
  "errors": 0.04
}
```

Maya K: looks transient. errors are 4% but mostly 429/503 from rate-limit. No customer-facing alerts in customer-ops. Quick mitigation: silence alert for 15m and add narrow suppress on the synthetic key.

Maya K: /pd silence PD-INC-4789 15m

pagerduty-bot: Silence created by Maya K (15m) — reason: noisy synthetic burst. Escalations paused.

Ron P: took node-level sample, see KV cache warmup on rtr-emb-02 at 15:32:10 — small mem pressure then GC spike, likely coincident with synthetic fanout.

Santi: proposed followup: add synthetic traffic tag to synthetic clients and exclude from this alert, also reduce sensitivity on p95 for embedder to 1.8s for 1h to avoid churn while we investigate.

Priya L: opening follow-up ticket INF-2251, tagging customer-impact:false but include runbook.

Maya K: handoff in 10. I'm going offline for scheduled call in 12m — handing to Ron.

Maya K: Ron, you're primary for next 30m if it re-fires.

Ron P: ack. I'll keep watch, unsubscribed suppression will auto-lift at 15m.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Page auto-resolved (no further alerts) — PD-INC-4789 cleared at +3m

Ron P: seeing metrics trending back to normal. p95 down to 0.42s now.

Santi: note for postmortem: tune synthetic tagging + add KV-cache warmup smoothing to embeddings alert. No customer impact observed (no support tickets).

Priya L: created INF-2251 and assigned to Santi, link: https://issues.redwood.com/INF-2251

Maya K: closing thread. :thumbsup:

Ron P: thanks, will follow up in the ticket.

incident-bot: Thread archived."
